searchText: The genesis handling PR is very minor and clarifies an edge case we all need to handle. If it was a large change that genuinely made it harder to understand the spec I could be convinced to leave it out. In this case I don’t think it affects readability at all. let’s just merge it in? <@592004585506340885> <@755590043632140352> <@602753420033785856> <@358120958726373381> <@412614104222531604> we have merged this PR. anything else open? or ready for a new release ? That's all that I had planned to merge. Just started this tests action. https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/actions/runs/24605792104 I'll give clients a day to verify the tests are fine. I'll start the release action this time tomorrow. So it's available Monday morning for Australians.
